product_one_liner.value: Sprinto is an autonomous GRC platform that brings audits, vendor oversight, and risk management into one system for fast-scaling SaaS businesses.
product_one_liner.notes: Sprinto describes its platform as built for fast-scaling SaaS businesses and says it brings audits, vendor oversight, and risk into one system.

pricing_page.notes: The cited Sprinto pricing page presents a Growth plan for teams automating compliance, even though it directs visitors to contact sales for pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Sprinto's customer-logo section names Whatfix and HackerRank among the organizations that trust Sprinto. | named_customers.0: The customer-logo section names Whatfix. | named_customers.1: The customer-logo section names HackerRank.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile states a company size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The sprinto.com-matched company record lists San Francisco, and the company LinkedIn profile identifies San Francisco as headquarters. | hq_country: The company record matched to sprinto.com lists San Francisco, United States; the company LinkedIn profile also identifies San Francisco as headquarters. This distinguishes the requested site from another similarly named record.

founded_year.notes: The Sprinto job-page excerpt states that the company was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents Sprinto's blog as a GRC insights collection and lists industry/compliance topics, not two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built; under the stated criteria this is false.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation links to multiple articles, including API structure and pagination, so it meets the several-articles requirement.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Sprinto job posting titled AI Implementation Intern describes AI development and AI infrastructure work, meeting the role-title criterion.

model_provider.notes: Sprinto's AI governance page names OpenAI and Anthropic. The evidence identifies the providers but does not specify which models are used for every product feature.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Sprinto's trust/compliance page marks SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and HIPAA as compliant. PCI DSS is not among the listed items. | compliance_certs.0: The trust page marks SOC 2 compliant. | compliance_certs.1: The trust page marks ISO 27001 compliant. | compliance_certs.2: The trust page marks HIPAA compliant. | compliance_certs.3: The trust page marks GDPR compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding history and the round announcement identify the latest round as Series B. | funding_date: The funding history dates Sprinto's Series B to April 2024, represented as 2024-04. | funding_amount_usd: The funding history lists the Series B amount as $20,000,000, and the round announcement independently reports a $20 million raise.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding history and announcement identify April 2024 as the latest round, which predates the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sprinto's careers listing includes a live Founding Sales Development Representative posting with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Sprinto's July–August 2026 product-updates post describes product/feature updates and was updated October 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Karthik Vemparala's profile identifies his Sprinto role as VP, Solutions and Customer Experience and records an end date of 2026-06-01, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Sprinto GTM job posting explicitly names HubSpot as the CRM in its GTM stack description. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting names HubSpot as the CRM.
